why_it_matters.text: Critical safety risks have emerged from Class I recalls involving microbial contamination in Greenwich Rx's Glutathione Injection and particulate matter contamination in Par Health's Argatroban Injection (D-0084-2027, D-0082-2027, D-0083-2027).
